items.title: Bring high-performance analytics to your lakehouse with ClickHouse and Amazon S3 Tables
items.summary: Learn how to bring ClickHouse's high-performance engine directly to data in Amazon S3 Tables using bidirectional connectivity. Query your Iceberg tables in place, run transformations in ClickHouse SQL, and write curated results back, while S3 Tables remain the single open source of truth.
items.creator: Karolina Ruiz Rogelj
